call_points.text: FY27 ESOP cost guided at ₹150 Cr, falling to ₹25-30 Cr in FY28.
Annual capex guided at ₹250-300 Cr, funded from a near-debt-free balance sheet.
Companion-animal tablet plant targeted for January-February, ready for exhibit batch.
API was flat QoQ on customer wait-and-watch; management expects Q2FY27 to be the best API quarter.
Emerging markets volume grew 25% in Q1FY27, led by Turkey, Brazil and Mexico.
Gross margin improved to 54.1% from 51.9% YoY, up ~220 bps.
Net debt at ₹86 Cr, 0.1x EBITDA, down from 0.24x last quarter and almost 1x a year ago.
High-potent oncology revenue starts only from FY29, with big formulation revenue after 2030.
Management targets $1 billion revenue by 2032, an 18% CAGR from FY27.
Management expects sustainable long-term annual revenue growth of around 15%.
Innovator business in CDMO/life cycle management expected to grow 40% in FY27 on a base of ₹200-225 Cr.
Average corporate tax rate expected to normalize to ~27% in FY27 as entities transition to the new tax regime.
Minority interest in US (Appco) and Spain subsidiaries accounts for ~20% of consolidated PAT.
Expanding companion animal portfolio with plans to develop 7-8 new products annually.
Q4 was the strongest quarter in company history as merger synergies began reflecting meaningfully.
Merger is in effect with full focus on synergy realization for the next 12 months.
In India, partnered with Boehringer Ingelheim for distribution of companion animal portfolio.
Management continues to navigate geopolitical and maritime disruptions via disciplined asset utilization and agile pricing.
With a deleveraged balance sheet, company is actively evaluating selective inorganic opportunities.

operating_notes.text: Board approved the grant of 1,30,98,000 employee stock options under the Viyash Scientific Limited Employee Stock Option Scheme 2026.
FY26 audited consolidated revenue stood at ₹3,420.31 Cr with net profit of ₹224.65 Cr.
In Q4FY26, completed validation of 6 APIs and 1 FDF, with an R&D pipeline of 19 products.
CDMO innovator business current base stands at ₹200–225 Cr.
Goodwill amortization was ₹100 Cr in FY26 and will reduce to ₹35 Cr in FY27.
India Ratings affirmed IND AA-/Stable/IND A1+ on ₹35 Cr bank facilities and simultaneously withdrew the rating at the company's request.
Step-down arm Alivira Animal Health Limited entered into a binding agreement to acquire 100% of BioForLife Italia s.r.l. for EUR 16.975 Mn.
API contributes around 40-45% of revenue, split roughly two-thirds Human and one-third Animal.
US formulations revenue was ₹126 Cr of ₹554 Cr total formulations in Q1FY27.
Emerging markets volume grew 25% in Q1FY27, led by Turkey, Brazil and Mexico.

timeline.summary: Viyash Scientific received an [ICRA]AA- Stable credit rating for ₹185 Cr of bank facilities.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹919.96 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹52.11 Cr.
Viyash Scientific presented Q4FY26 results showing EBITDA of ₹200.1 Cr (+64% YoY) and net debt reduction to ₹166.1 Cr.
Viyash Scientific Limited shared the earnings call audio recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 results on May 20, 2026, via its website.
Viyash Scientific held its Q4FY26 concall, guiding for 15% revenue growth and highlighting synergy run-rate targets of ₹125–150 Cr.
India Ratings affirmed ratings on ₹35 Cr bank facilities of Viyash Scientific at IND AA-/Stable/IND A1+ and simultaneously withdrew them at the company's request.
Alivira Animal Health signed a binding agreement to acquire 100% of Italy-based BioForLife Italia s.r.l. for EUR 16.975 million.
On its Q1FY27 earnings call (Aug 12, 2026), Viyash guided FY27 revenue growth of 13-15% and EBITDA margin of 20-22%, with net debt down to ₹86 Cr.
